external_games.name: I Want to Talk About My Friend

name: I Want to Talk About My Friend
storyline: You play as Gusion, a young girl who will soon mutate into a skeleton creature because powers of authority made some grave mistakes, and now the dead do not die. She and her kind have powerful abilities, but it doesn't really matter. After an attack on her home by ghouls known as the Beleth, she accompanies a giant named Eligos to find flowers which will heal the injured.
summary: "I Want To Talk About My Friend" is a horror game based on ancient folklore, but it's also a tribute to some friends gone too soon.
